versions.changelog:
Major update: Adds on-chain token operations on Base alongside Wise banking, with new wallet and token management features.

- Added support for creating and managing Ethereum wallets on the Base network.
- Introduced actions for buying, sending, and checking balances of ERC-20 tokens via Uniswap on Base.
- Extended environment variable options for optional on-chain functionality.
- Expanded documentation to cover new wallet/token actions and usage.
- Existing Wise API banking functions (check balance, receive/send money) retained and clarified.

Initial release of bank-skill — enables Wise banking actions for agents.

- Query multi-currency balances via Wise API
- Retrieve account/routing/IBAN details for receiving payments
- Send money to recipients (supports USD ACH and EUR IBAN transfers)
- Includes error handling for missing/invalid credentials, insufficient funds, and input validation
- Documentation provided for setup, usage, operations, and failure modes
